The '''R-3 Particle Beam Shrieker''' was a type of [[Particle beam/Legends|particle beam]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
